name: Rolling ground
description: Small bumps create short pockets of cover.

scenarios.name: Walk the ground
scenarios.description: Unarmed movement experiment. Watch both soldiers follow the surface at 47 units/s along slopes.

scenarios.name: Rifle cover
scenarios.description: Two stationary riflemen 240 units apart. Green means visible; amber means terrain blocks their sight line.

scenarios.name: Rockets over cover
scenarios.description: Rocketeers can target ground positions behind a hill in this experiment. Watch scattered arcs hit the first terrain they reach.

scenarios.name: Red holds high ground
scenarios.description: Red holds the high ground while Blue walks uphill and fires when terrain and range allow.

scenarios.name: Blue holds high ground
scenarios.description: Blue holds the high ground while Red walks uphill and fires when terrain and range allow.

scenarios.name: Blue approaches first
scenarios.description: Both walk and fire. Blue begins nearer the high ground; compare first shots, health and result.

scenarios.name: Red approaches first
scenarios.description: Both walk and fire. Red begins nearer the high ground; compare first shots, health and result.

scenarios.name: Rockets: Blue nearer
scenarios.description: Uneven rocketeer approach. Stop to aim when a terrain-clearing shot is available at a height-dependent reachable distance; watch variable launch angles and long-range scatter.

scenarios.name: Rockets: Red nearer
scenarios.description: Uneven rocketeer approach. Stop to aim when a terrain-clearing shot is available at a height-dependent reachable distance; watch variable launch angles and long-range scatter.
